description: Deterministic scoring contract for how closely a model run follows the track plan and specification.

evidence.rule: A captured test or verification commit with test_status=fail precedes the first implementation commit in commits order.
A captured test or verification commit with test_status=pass follows the implementation commit and records the command or check that passed.

dimensions.derived: tdd_followed is true only when both evidence items are present; otherwise it is false.

evidence.rule: At least one implementation or verification commit records a reference to spec.md, the specification, or an acceptance-criteria identifier in its subject, body, or references list.

dimensions.derived: spec_referenced is true when spec_reference is present; otherwise it is false.

evidence.rule: Every task in the captured plan snapshot has final status=x; an empty task list receives zero points.
Completed task ordinals are contiguous and appear in the same order as the plan snapshot; missing or reordered ordinals receive zero points.
The captured verification object contains a non-empty test command and an explicit pass or fail result.
The captured verification object contains a non-empty lint command and an explicit error count.

input_contract.source: captured run artifact; the scorer must not shell out to git, access a live repository, or call a model API

missing_evidence_policy: Treat missing, empty, unknown, or not_run evidence as false and award zero points for that evidence item. Do not infer adherence from wall time, tool-call count, commit count, or a successful process exit alone.

field_types.dimension_scores: object keyed by rubric dimension id
field_types.evidence: object keyed by evidence id with boolean values
